I will manage this sorghum plot the way I can afford, not in a big way. I own the land, so I will put some manure there and a small amount of chemical fertilizer, but I will not spend too much because I still have other plots to cover. I will keep my local seed because I know how it behaves here, and on sorghum I usually do not buy pesticide unless I see a real problem. I depend on rain, and most of the work on this plot I will do with my family, with only a little hired help at peak time.
